title: Simple Interactions
description: Modern social plugin for Minecraft servers with friends, profiles, stats, bios, badges, likes, privacy, and GUI menus.
body:
# SimpleInteractions

SimpleInteractions is a modern social interaction plugin for Minecraft servers that combines player profiles and friends into one clean system.

It gives players a better way to connect, view profiles, track stats, manage friends, customize bios, earn badges, like profiles, and use polished GUI menus.

## Features

✔ Friends system  
✔ Friend requests  
✔ Friends GUI  
✔ Player profiles  
✔ Profile GUI menus  
✔ Stats tracking  
✔ Player bios  
✔ Likes system  
✔ Badge system  
✔ Privacy settings  
✔ Blocking system  
✔ Favorites  
✔ Teleport requests  
✔ Last seen tracking  
✔ Online status  
✔ SQLite storage  
✔ Configurable messages  
✔ Clean and secure GUI system  

## Commands

/interactions  
/si  
/profile  
/profile <player>  
/profile setbio <text>  
/profile clearbio  
/profile like <player>  
/profile privacy  
/friends  
/friends add <player>  
/friends accept <player>  
/friends deny <player>  
/friends remove <player>  
/friends block <player>  
/friends unblock <player>  
/friends favorite <player>  
/friends tp <player>  

## Admin Commands

/interactionsadmin reload  
/interactionsadmin info <player>  
/interactionsadmin reset <player>  
/interactionsadmin badge give <player> <badge>  
/interactionsadmin badge remove <player> <badge>  
/interactionsadmin friends clear <player>  
/interactionsadmin blocks clear <player>  

## Perfect For

Survival servers  
SMP servers  
Community servers  
Minigame hubs  
Network lobbies  
Friend groups  

## Compatibility

SimpleInteractions currently supports Minecraft 1.21.x servers running Java 21.

Supported server software:
- Paper
- Purpur
- Pufferfish
- Spigot

26.1+ support is planned for a future update.

## Storage

SimpleInteractions uses SQLite by default.  
No external database setup is required.

## Planned Updates

- Leaderboards  
- Economy support  
- DiscordSRV support  
- More profile cosmetics  
- More integrations  
- Public profile cards  

## Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join my Discord for support and updates.
